limitations: Static MCU bytes are owner OTA; installed MCU hash is not matched.
Only the reset-entry RAM-clear path and direct encoded global accesses were established. Indirect writes and all reset/resume paths are not exhaustively excluded.
The32-bit ADD/ST.W counter wraps modulo2^32; wrap period in seconds is not qualified.
Source has explicit timer stop/restart; observed ticking is not a continuous wall-time contract.
Reload24000 is a hardware count. The input frequency/prescaler chain is not followed, so no authoritative milliseconds unit is promoted.
The saved raw header counters advance at approximately1000 ticks per arrival second. Arrival jitter and one short stationary window limit this empirical comparison.
A cached last-change tick may predate the GET while the angle remains current and constant. Neither the modular difference nor a changing stamp proves acquisition freshness.
A one-snapshot modular delta does not resolve boot/reset boundaries, completed wraps, or sensor age.
